explication: howler.js is a browser audio library with one public API for loading and controlling sounds, using Web Audio by default and HTML5 Audio as a fallback. Its core covers source loading, playback, sound lifecycle, and playback controls; the optional spatial plugin adds stereo panning and 3D positioning. The README documents sprites, caching, codec selection, and global/group controls. Source excerpts show backend setup and playback details, but do not expose the complete loading or cache implementation, so those links rely on README statements.
